title: Adaptive Robust Confidence Sets in High Dimensions
abstract: arXiv:2610.15723v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study adaptive confidence sets for mean vectors of multivariate Gaussians with identity covariance under Huber contamination when the contamination proportion is unknown. We show that an information-theoretically optimal adaptive confidence set can be constructed by simultaneously quantifying uncertainty across all one-dimensional projections. The resulting confidence set achieves the optimal diameter and reveals a substantial adaptation cost compared with the minimax estimation error.   Although statistically optimal, this construction is computationally infeasible. We establish a Statistical Query (SQ) lower bound showing that achieving diameter $O(m^{-1/2})$ requires either exponentially many queries or query tolerance $d^{-\Omega(m)}$. translated_title: 高维自适应稳健置信集
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在污染比例未知的情况下，具有单位协方差的多变量高斯分布的均值向量在Huber污染模型下的自适应置信集。我们证明了通过同时量化所有一维投影的不确定性，可以构造出信息论意义上最优的自适应置信集。所得到的置信集达到了最优直径，并揭示了与极小极大估计误差相比存在显著的自适应代价。尽管这一构造在统计上是最优的，但在计算上是不可行的。我们建立了一个统计查询（SQ）下界，表明要达到直径 $O(m^{-1/2})$ 需要指数级数量的查询，或查询容差为 $d^{-\Omega(m)}$。因此，与稳健均值估计不同，对未知污染比例的自适应在SQ框架内既带来统计代价，又带来计算上的障碍。最后，我们……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文证明了在污染比例未知的高维Huber污染模型下，通过同时量化所有一维投影的不确定性可构造信息论最优的自适应置信集，但该构造不仅存在显著的自适应统计代价，还因统计查询下界而面临计算不可行的障碍。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that information-theoretically optimal adaptive confidence sets under unknown contamination proportion can be constructed by simultaneously quantifying uncertainty across all one-dimensional projections, yet this optimal construction incurs both a substantial statistical adaptation cost and a computational barrier, as shown by a Statistical Query lower bound.
